translated_title: Sheinbaum Delivers Power Plant; Without the CFE There Would Be No Sovereignty, She Stresses
original_title: Sheinbaum entrega central eléctrica; sin la CFE no habría soberanía, resalta
author: Juan Carlos Flores
meta_description: Inaugurating a combined-cycle plant in Manzanillo, Sheinbaum stressed that without the CFE there would be no national or energy sovereignty.
